remarks: It is very rare that a three bedroom condo comes on  the market in this building. It is all updated and in a well-maintained elevator building. This home stands out with exquisite lighting design throughout - crafted by the owner, a professional electrician, who has created a warm and inviting atmosphere with custom fixtures and thoughtful illumination in every room, including the closets. Enjoy rich wood floors, an open and functional layout, with plenty of natural light. This spacious open concept living and dining area flows seamlessly into a modern kitchen that needs to be seen to be appreciated for all the work done. Perfect for entertaining or relaxing. Whether you're a first-time owner, downsizing, or looking for a stylish space, this condo combines comfort, craftsmanship, and creativity in one exceptional package.There is even a storage area in the basement for the overflow of things. Your HOA includes one parking spot, basic cable, internet, heat, hot water, cooking gas, water, sewer, trash removal, grounds maintenance throughout the year, mowing and snow removal. Don't forget the outdoor seasonal pool, and a fitness room in the basement. There is a guard house upon entering with 24/7 security. Convenient to I-95, downtown shopping, dining, movies, theatre, metro north, food stores, medical offices and so much more. If you have not been to Fountain Terrace then you are missing out. This charming three bedroom condo will surely not last long.
